principle: Separate source observations, proposed policy, reference outputs, audit-only outcomes, and runtime inputs.

dialog[*].content_before_target.note: Use only the prefix available before the response. Preserve sequence and speaker.

dialog[*].speaker.note: One supporter response can contain multiple adjacent messages.

dialog[target].annotation.strategy.note: Not a verified optimal policy; keep separate from human_approved_strategy.

dialog[target_block].content.note: Never pass the target response to the router as if it were prior context.

emotion_type.note: Source-level label, not a diagnosis or a current per-turn emotion assessment.

problem_type.note: Do not equate topic to response strategy or safety level.

situation.note: Use as runtime context only if the product actually collects this information before that turn; otherwise it can leak unavailable context.

survey_score.note: Do not treat overall scores as per-turn causal efficacy or safety. Missing scores are unknown, not zero.

dialog[later].annotation.feedback.note: Source placement does not establish that a score rates just one immediately preceding sentence.

seeker_question1/seeker_question2/suppor.note: May include collection-interface commentary rather than therapeutic content.

conv_id.note: Never split individual rows of one conversation across development and held-out evaluation.

conv_id_hit_prefix.note: Paired conversations sharing a hit may be related; inspect before final split. This is a proposed grouping rule, not an official split.

speaker_idx.note: Not a global 0=user/1=assistant flag. Infer within-conversation roles and validate alternation.

utterance.note: Decode _comma_ after parsing. Do not use storyteller continuations as listener targets.

context.note: In this upload the label is constant within each conversation; do not assume it labels every turn correctly.

prompt.note: This column is NOT the product system prompt. It is unavailable runtime context unless collected from the actual user.

selfeval.note: Do not invent the meaning of each position in the score string.

tags.note: Do not equate these tokens with ESConv support strategies or a clinical safety label.
